article.hook: A house feels suddenly bigger, or a phone call from home takes longer. Jupiter in Cancer spreads wide through what holds us close, reshaping comfort over the next year.
article.lived: Over the months, we expand by caring more deeply and defending what matters at home and work. It’s that extra hour spent fixing a meal for someone, or the new role you take to protect a team, all stretching your sense of belonging. Our networks grow through patience and emotional reach, not speed or size. The pace is slow enough to notice the weight of every kindness and the pull of old loyalties.
article.turn: The same care that opens us can also trap us in what’s familiar, making us hold on too tight and smother the very growth we want. When protection turns into possession, generosity becomes a cage. Let go hard when you notice your kindness turning into a lock on someone else’s life.
moves: Offer to organize a shared meal or space that includes someone new to your usual circle.
Write a letter or send a message expressing gratitude to a family member or close friend for their support.
Set a weekly boundary around work time to protect your emotional recharge and home life.
